spec.kitLine: After 5 normal attacks: Roar Crit Rate ▲
spec.scope: Generic Critical Rate (unscoped critRatePct) — the line says 'Critical Rate', not 'of normal attacks', so it lifts skill/burst crit too where crit-eligible.
spec.durationSemantics: Named stacking buff 'Roar': 2.62% per stack, maxStacks 5, durationSec 5 — each application refreshes the shared 5s timer (engine same-key refresh convention). NOT rounds, NOT permanent. Whether max stacks is sustainable depends on the ⚑ SG cadence tuple: 5 pulls must land inside 5s or stacks reset.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:5 — and 'normal attack' for an SG counts ROUNDS (trigger pulls), NOT pellets. Leona's hitsPerShot is 10 pellets; counting pellets would fire the trigger every half-pull.
spec.nearestWrongModel: hitCount counting pellet HITS instead of rounds — with hitsPerShot 10, stacks would cap after ~3 pulls and be trivially permanent, over-crediting Roar uptime AND making the burst's max-stack gate trivially always-open.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Under onEvent, the first buffApply with stat critRatePct value 2.62 (key Roar) occurs at Leona's 5th shot event, not her 1st; stacks on the buffApply increment by 1 per 5 subsequent shots, reaching stacks===5 only after 25 pulls. Red under pellet-counting (first apply at shot 1, stacks 5 by shot 3).
spec.inertness: Must not apply at t=0 (not a passive); must not exceed maxStacks 5; must not scope to SG-only (that's the burst rider, a different line).

spec.scope: SG effective-range extension — changes the range-band landing fraction for SG allies, so it IS damage-relevant (weapon-state class, taxonomy #6), not a defensive skip.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:15 (rounds, same pellet caveat as line 1)
spec.targetSet: alliesOfWeapon SG (all shotgun allies, including self)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Silently dropping it with no unmodeled record, or inventing a proxy damage buff for it. The effect schema has NO StatKey for maximum effective range, so it cannot be encoded as a block today.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply with any invented proxy stat may be attributable to this line; the override's unmodeled.skill1 must carry the line verbatim. Structural assertion: no block keyed hitCount:15 emits a damage-bucket stat.
spec.inertness: Must move nothing in the current engine; its absence from unmodeled would be a silent drop.

spec.kitLine: On entering Full Burst: Hit Rate ▲ 20.28%
spec.scope: Hit Rate — engine hitRatePct, which feeds the hrCoreMult core-hit lift path (live by default). Not a generic damage stat.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10, refreshed at each FB entry
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team FB, regardless of who cast B2. NOT burstCast.
spec.nearestWrongModel: burstCast — since Leona is Burst II and shares the tier with another B2 in most fixtures (crown in controlComp), a burstCast keying would skip every rotation where the other B2 casts, under-crediting; conversely the HR→core conversion slope could be silently invented (it is measured-only ⚑, ALWAYS-⚑ field 7).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat hitRatePct value 20.28 fires paired with EVERY fullBurstStart event, including rotations where no burstCast event with Leona's srcSlot precedes it. Red under burstCast keying (missing applies on the other B2's rotations).
spec.inertness: Must not apply outside a Full Burst window; the 20.28% kit value is fixed — only the HR→core slope is the ⚑, never the stat value.

spec.kitLine: FB enter: pellets ▲ 5, 2 top-ATK SG allies
spec.scope: Flat pellet-count add (pelletCountFlat 5) on the SG landing path — extra pellets take the same per-pellet landing fraction / range falloff / shot-level core as base pellets. NOT a normal-attack % proxy.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter (any team FB), same literal clause as skill2 line 1
spec.targetSet: The 2 SG-wielding allies with the highest FINAL ATK — the kit says 'final ATK' literally, so byFinalAtk:true (live effectiveAtk ranking, the A3 rule). Critically this is FILTER-then-RANK: rank among SG wielders only.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) alliesTopAtk count:2 over ALL allies with the buff inert on non-SG recipients — rank-then-filter. If a non-SG unit is top-2 by final ATK, the 2nd-ranked SG unit loses the buff under this misread but keeps it under the faithful filter-then-rank reading. (b) static-ATK ranking (byFinalAtk omitted) despite the literal 'final ATK'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a comp with ≥3 SG units where a non-SG ally holds top-2 final ATK, buffApply events with stat pelletCountFlat value 5 target exactly the two highest-final-ATK SG slugs (targetSlug ∈ SG set, count 2), including the SG unit ranked 3rd overall. Red under rank-then-filter (only 1 effective recipient).
spec.inertness: Non-SG allies must never gain effective pellets; gauge must NOT be pumped by the extra pellets (energy is per-trigger); with no co-active normalAttackPct the damage delta vs a +50% normal-mult proxy is ~neutral, so the assertion must check effectivePellets/targeting, not just totals.

spec.scope: Generic critDamagePct — applies to all crit-eligible hits of all allies
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — a burst-block line with no activation clause fires when LEONA casts her own Burst II, which is PRE-FB (lands before the FB window opens). NOT fullBurstEnter.
spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter — the classic taxonomy-#3 over-credit. With a second Burst II unit in the team (crown in the standard controlComp), rotations where the OTHER B2 casts would still grant Leona's burst buff under the misread; faithfully they must not.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Every buffApply with stat critDamagePct value 34.64 is preceded in the same rotation by a burstCast event from Leona's srcSlot; on rotations where the co-B2 casts instead, NO such buffApply occurs. Red under fullBurstEnter keying (an apply on every FB).
spec.inertness: Must not fire on team FBs Leona did not burst into; a lone-B3-style fixture error (no B1/B2 chain) would make it never fire — the fixture must let Leona actually win B2 casts.

spec.kitLine: When Roar at max stacks: Crit Rate ▲ SG
spec.scope: Generic critRatePct 21.32 but TARGET-scoped to shotgun wielders only
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast GATED on the Roar stack pool being at max (5) at cast time. The gate needs a stateful check — e.g. Roar mirrored as a resource with resourceGate {min:5}, or an equivalent stack-conditioned mechanism. Because Roar needs 25 pulls with 5s-refresh survival, the gate is genuinely OPEN-or-CLOSED at the first burst (~20s) depending on the ⚑ SG cadence — it is not trivially always-open.
spec.targetSet: alliesOfWeapon SG (all shotgun allies, including self) — NOT all allies
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping the max-stack gate (unconditional rider on every burst cast) — over-credits early bursts before 25 pulls accrue; second misread: target 'all allies' instead of SG-only, over-crediting non-SG teammates' crit.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat critRatePct value 21.32 (i) targets only SG-wielding slugs, and (ii) occurs on a given Leona burstCast ONLY IF the latest Roar buffApply before that cast frame shows stacks===5 with expiresFrame beyond the cast frame. A patched-override run that suppresses Roar stacking (withPatchedOverride removing the skill1 block) must show ZERO 21.32 applies. Red under the ungated misread (applies on every cast, including the Roar-suppressed run).
spec.inertness: Non-SG allies must never receive the 21.32; the rider must not fire when Roar is below 5 stacks (including a first burst that beats stack accrual).

skill1: Maximum Effective Range ▲ 20% for 10 sec (all SG allies, after 15 normal attacks)

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to check hardest: (1) SG round-vs-pellet counting on both hitCount triggers — hitsPerShot is 10, so a pellet-counted hitCount:5 fires ~every half pull and makes Roar trivially max-stacked, which ALSO silently opens the burst rider's gate; the two errors compound. (2) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter split across the kit: skill2 lines say 'when entering Full Burst' (fullBurstEnter), burst lines have no clause (burstCast) — a uniform keying either way is wrong on exactly half the kit, and the standard controlComp (crown = co-B2) is the fixture that exposes it, since Leona and crown compete for the B2 cast. Verify the fixture actually lets Leona cast some rotations (slot order / first-ready), else the burst lines are untestable. (3) The pellet line's target is filter-then-rank ('highest final ATK AND a Shotgun'): the schema has alliesTopAtk (no weapon facet) and alliesOfWeapon (no ranking) but no combined kind — if the driver proxied with alliesTopAtk+inert-on-non-SG, that is a real divergence whenever a non-SG ally is top-2 by final ATK, and byFinalAtk:true is required by the literal 'final ATK' wording. (4) Skill1's range line is damage-relevant (SG landing fraction) but has no StatKey — it must appear verbatim in unmodeled, not be silently dropped or proxied. (5) Whether Roar's 5 stacks are sustainable rides entirely on the ⚑ SG cadence tuple (ammo 9, reloadFrames 111): at ~1 pull/s a stack lands every ~5s against a 5s refresh window — marginal, so the first-burst gate state is genuinely undetermined without the cadence pin; the test must not bake in an assumed pass/fail of the gate at first burst without deriving cadence from the engine's own shot events.
